# @rxova/react-time-input

> A headless, accessible time field for React: segmented, keyboard-first, 12- or
> 24-hour by locale through `Intl`, with no clock popup and no date library. The
> value is always a canonical 24-hour `HH:mm` (or `HH:mm:ss`) string, whatever
> the field displays. Zero runtime dependencies. No stylesheet to import.

## Install

    npm install @rxova/react-time-input

`react >= 18` is the only peer dependency.

## Minimal working example

```tsx
import { useState } from 'react'
import { TimeInput } from '@rxova/react-time-input'

export function Booking() {
  const [value, setValue] = useState<string | null>(null)

  return <TimeInput label="Start time" value={value} onChange={setValue} min="09:00" max="17:00" />
}
```

The clock and the segment order follow the locale; the value does not:

```tsx
import { TimeInput } from '@rxova/react-time-input'

export function Examples() {
  return (
    <>
      <TimeInput label="US" locale="en-US" />
      <TimeInput label="UK" locale="en-GB" />
      <TimeInput label="Precise" showSeconds minuteStep={15} secondStep={30} />
    </>
  )
}
```

## Props

`<TimeInput>` — the full surface is `TimeInputProps` in the published types.

| Prop | Type | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | `string \| null` | — | Controlled `HH:mm` or `HH:mm:ss`, 24-hour, or `null` for empty. |
| `defaultValue` | `string \| null` | — | Uncontrolled initial value. Ignored when `value` is set. |
| `onChange` | `(value: string \| null) => void` | — | Fires on complete/valid, and when that stops. Never mid-entry. |
| `onPartsChange` | `(parts: TimeParts) => void` | — | Every keystroke, including while incomplete. |
| `min` | `string` | — | Earliest allowed time, inclusive, `HH:mm[:ss]`. |
| `max` | `string` | — | Latest allowed time, inclusive, `HH:mm[:ss]`. |
| `emitOutOfRange` | `boolean` | `true` | Reports an out-of-range time and marks the field invalid, rather than discarding it. |
| `showSeconds` | `boolean` | `false` | Adds a seconds segment. |
| `hour12` | `boolean` | whatever the locale uses | Forces a 12- or 24-hour clock. Display only. |
| `minuteStep` | `number` | `1` | Arrow-key step for minutes. Must divide 60. |
| `secondStep` | `number` | `1` | Arrow-key step for seconds. Must divide 60. |
| `locale` | `string` | the runtime's locale | BCP 47 tag deciding segment order, separators and the clock. |
| `placeholders` | `TimePlaceholders` | `hh` / `mm` / `ss` / `--` | Per-segment placeholder text. |
| `segmentLabels` | `TimeSegmentLabels` | `Hour` / `Minute` / `Second` / `AM/PM` | Per-segment accessible name. |
| `renderSegment` | `(state: TimeSegmentState) => ReactNode` | — | Custom rendering for one segment. |
| `label` | `ReactNode` | — | Accessible name for the whole field. |
| `className` | `string` | — | |
| `style` | `CSSProperties` | — | |
| `name` | `string` | — | Emits a hidden input carrying the 24-hour value, readable by a native `<form>`. |
| `required` | `boolean` | `false` | |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` | |
| `readOnly` | `boolean` | `false` | |
| `dir` | `'ltr' \| 'rtl'` | inherited | Lays the field out; segment order still comes from `locale`. |
| `invalid` | `boolean` | `false` | Sets `aria-invalid` and `data-invalid` on the group. |
| `aria-describedby` | `string` | — | ids of external error/help text. |
| `id` | `string` | — | Base id; segments derive `${id}-hour`, `${id}-minute`, … |
| `onBlur` | `(event: FocusEvent<HTMLElement>) => void` | — | Fires when focus leaves the field, never between segments. |
| `onFocus` | `(event: FocusEvent<HTMLElement>) => void` | — | |
| `onWarn` | `(warning: TimeWarning) => void` | `console.warn` | Development-only notice that a prop was coerced. Stripped from production builds. |

Also exported: the `useTimeInput` hook, the segment helpers `timePieces`,
`dayPeriodNames`, `usesHour12`, and the pure time functions `toISO`, `fromISO`,
`compareISO`, `withinRange`, `toDisplayHour`, `fromDisplayHour`, `toDayPeriod`,
plus the `AM` and `PM` constants.

## Styling

There is no stylesheet. Set CSS custom properties on any ancestor:
`--rx-time-gap`, `--rx-time-segment-padding`, `--rx-time-segment-radius`,
`--rx-time-literal-opacity`, `--rx-time-focus-ring`,
`--rx-time-focus-ring-offset`.

The focused segment paints a ring by default (`2px solid Highlight`), because a
`<span role="spinbutton">` gets none from the browser. Restyle it through those
two properties rather than removing it.

Or target the `data-*` attributes, which are public API covered by semver:
`data-rx-time-root`, `data-rx-time-segment` (`hour` / `minute` / `second` / `dayPeriod`),
`data-rx-time-value`, plus the state hooks `data-complete`, `data-out-of-range`,
`data-placeholder`, `data-focused`, `data-disabled`, `data-readonly`,
`data-invalid`.

## Three mistakes to avoid

1. **Reading `hour12` off the value.** The value is 24-hour always — `'13:30'`
   even when the field shows `1:30 PM`. `hour12` is a display choice, so a value
   can be stored, compared and sorted without knowing which locale produced it.
2. **Turning the value into a `Date`.** A time of day is not an instant; it has no
   date and no timezone until you pair it with one, and `new Date('13:30')` does
   not parse at all. Keep the string and use `compareISO` / `withinRange`.
3. **Setting a `minuteStep` that does not divide 60.** `7` would make the arrows
   walk off the hour boundary and never return to `:00`; the component warns and
   falls back to `1` rather than doing that silently.
